t: Storage Control and Dump modules are Screen modules that work through a linked Storage Scanner. Sneak right-click a scanner with the module to set its target.
存储控制模块与倾倒模块均为显示屏模块，通过已链接的存储检测器运作。对该检测器潜行右键使用模块，即可设定其目标。
The Storage Control Module watches up to nine item filters and can count all inventories or only starred/routable inventories.
存储控制模块最多可监控九个物品过滤器，并可统计全部物品栏，或仅统计已标注星号/可路由的物品栏。
The Dump Module pushes matching player inventory items into the linked scanner network. It can use common item tags for broader matching.
销毁模块会将匹配玩家物品栏的物品推送至已链接的扫描器网络中。它支持使用通用物品标签以实现更宽泛的匹配范围。
